findings.evidence: template/scripts/pr_review_gate.py:12-13 imports lifecycle_workers and publication_queue at module level, before managed_candidate calls lifecycle_mode at line 22. Thus importing managed_candidate with either coordinator dependency unavailable raises before a downstream contract can answer False. This contradicts the lifecycle-workers delta requirement that the coordinator stack SHALL be loaded only after the committed contract selected coordinator mode.
findings.summary: Calling the downstream candidacy API still requires loading coordinator modules before contract selection.

findings.evidence: The completion-lifecycle delta requires archive, publication and Requirement entrypoints to use one selector before source-only logic and reject unsupported source combinations. template/scripts/project_publish.py:648-649 checks only platform_version == 'source' before importing publication_queue, without lifecycle_mode. template/scripts/finish_task.py:904-905 similarly imports pr_review_gate before its selector runs, and lines 915-916 import publication_queue using only source/PR/branch conditions. Neither file calls lifecycle_mode. Consequently the new contract boundary is not enforced across publication entrypoints.
findings.summary: Finish and publication paths still bypass the required shared selector, allowing source-only logic before unsupported source contracts are rejected.
